title: Constructive courage on a team
opening_case: A junior employee spots a plausible error in a team plan but hesitates to speak.

nodes.prompt: A junior employee spots a plausible error in a team plan but hesitates to speak. Choose your first response.

nodes.prompt: The plan indeed needs revision. What next?

choices.text: Interpret speaking up as proof of exceptional character

nodes.prompt: The data remain ambiguous. What next?

choices.text: Present the uncertainty and ask for review

choices.text: Stay silent forever because certainty is impossible
